objective: Check that the version-source and dependency-updater branches still pass their gates after merging release/0.2.1/integration (with the Windows lock fix) forward.
scope: Worktrees, in order: /home/user/holyagent-build-version-source, /home/user/holyagent-build-dependency-updater. Each HEAD is a fresh merge commit.

In each: run 'bunx --no-install mise run build', then 'git status --short' (any changed file means the committed dist was out of sync: list the files and do not revert them), then 'bunx --no-install mise run verify'.
constraints: Keep working until both are checked; stop to ask only when you cannot go on. When done, stop and report. Make no git writes and edit no files yourself; the build may regenerate dist files, which you list.
Report in under 150 words: per worktree the build exit, the changed files after build, the verify exit and test counts.

criteria.text: Each of the two heads builds with dist in sync and passes mise run verify
